title: The Priestly Order of Melchizedek

questions.question: For this Melchizedek, king of ____, priest of the Most High God, met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:1 (ESV): "For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of the Most High God, met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,"

questions.question: and to him Abraham apportioned a ____ part of everything.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:2 (ESV): "and to him Abraham apportioned a tenth part of everything. He is first, by translation of his name, king of righteousness, and then he is also king of Salem, that is, king of peace."

questions.question: He is first, by translation of his name, king of ____, and then he is also king of Salem, that is, king of peace.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:2 (ESV): "...He is first, by translation of his name, king of righteousness, and then he is also king of Salem, that is, king of peace."

questions.question: He is without father or mother or genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but resembling the Son of God he continues a ____ forever.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:3 (ESV): "He is without father or mother or genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but resembling the Son of God he continues a priest forever."

questions.question: See how great this man was to whom Abraham the ____ gave a tenth of the spoils!
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:4 (ESV): "See how great this man was to whom Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth of the spoils!"

questions.question: It is beyond dispute that the inferior is blessed by the ____.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:7 (ESV): "It is beyond dispute that the inferior is blessed by the superior."

questions.question: One might even say that ____ himself, who receives tithes, paid tithes through Abraham, for he was still in the loins of his ancestor when Melchizedek met him.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:9-10 (ESV): "One might even say that Levi himself, who receives tithes, paid tithes through Abraham, for he was still in the loins of his ancestor when Melchizedek met him."

questions.question: Now if perfection had been attainable through the Levitical priesthood... what further need would there have been for another priest to arise after the order of ____
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:11 (ESV): "Now if perfection had been attainable through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people received the law), what further need would there have been for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, rather than one named after the order of Aaron?"

questions.question: For when there is a change in the priesthood, there is necessarily a change in the ____ as well.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:12 (ESV): "For when there is a change in the priesthood, there is necessarily a change in the law as well."

questions.question: For it is evident that our Lord was descended from ____, and in connection with that tribe Moses said nothing about priests.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:14 (ESV): "For it is evident that our Lord was descended from Judah, and in connection with that tribe Moses said nothing about priests."

questions.question: This becomes even more evident when another priest arises in the likeness of Melchizedek, who has become a priest, not on the basis of a legal requirement concerning bodily descent, but by the power of an indestructible ____.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:15-16 (ESV): "This becomes even more evident when another priest arises in the likeness of Melchizedek, who has become a priest, not on the basis of a legal requirement concerning bodily descent, but by the power of an indestructible life."

questions.question: For on the one hand, a former commandment is set aside because of its ____ and uselessness
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:18 (ESV): "For on the one hand, a former commandment is set aside because of its weakness and uselessness"

questions.question: (for the law made nothing ____); but on the other hand, a better hope is introduced, through which we draw near to God.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:19 (ESV): "(for the law made nothing perfect); but on the other hand, a better hope is introduced, through which we draw near to God."

questions.question: This makes Jesus the guarantor of a ____ covenant.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:22 (ESV): "This makes Jesus the guarantor of a better covenant."

questions.question: Consequently, he is able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, since he always lives to make ____ for them.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:25 (ESV): "Consequently, he is able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, since he always lives to make intercession for them."

key_verse_text: Consequently, he is able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, since he always lives to make intercession for them.
